custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active tracked part, part A, with 5 in its bin.
  • Have two inactive tracked parts, part B and part C, with 5 each.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all three.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425590-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425590-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
  • A cycle count is running when the Inventory list shows a Count column with Save and Cancel above it; click Cancel to stop it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 2:

  • Parts B and C are listed.

Step 3:

  • The menu on the Inactive tab offers Cycle count.

Step 4:

  • The count starts on the Inactive tab: parts B and C are listed, each with an empty Count box.
  • Part A is not listed.

Step 5:

  • The count sheet lists parts B and C.
  • Part A is not on it.

Step 6:

  • The print preview closes and the count is still running.

Step 7:

  • The count ends without saving: parts B and C still show 5 Available.

Step 8:

  • The Active tab is selected.

Step 9:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 10:

  • The menu opens.

Step 11:

  • The count lists part A with a Count box.
  • Parts B and C are not listed.

Step 12:

  • The count ends without saving.
